approved_anchor.role: shield silhouette and material-language reference only; never downscaled into runtime pixels

anchor: One right-facing shield bearer using the existing cold-gray square-box robot identity and linear limbs.

move_m1: Eight poses in a 4x2 board; deliberate grounded long mechanical march.
Torso, shield, holding arm and shield details stay registered; only legs articulate.
move_m2: Eight poses in a 4x2 board; compact guarded patrol with short stride and heel lift.
Zero body bounce or shield motion; all eight leg phases remain unique.
shield_states_s1: Three states: intact, restrained branching cracks, heavily branched critical cracks.
Shield alpha silhouette and all robot pixels remain fixed; only interior face pixels change.
shield_states_s2: Three states: intact, one stepped diagonal fracture, critical diagonal fracture crossing the energy spine.
Observation slit and spine degrade without removing any outer shield pixel.
death_d1: Eight-frame shield-led forward collapse; lower shield edge briefly braces before the rigid body-shield assembly falls.
Shield remains connected to the hand and never breaks or detaches.
death_d2: Eight-frame rear-leg failure and sideways guarded collapse; shield settles diagonally over the body.
Shield remains a rigid connected plate throughout.
block_fx_b1: Three-frame sharp directional ricochet: compact hot core, angular star, sparse embers.
block_fx_b2: Three-frame compact mechanical deflection arc: hot bracket, broken chevron arc, sparse embers.
break_fx_x1: Five-frame rigid slab fragmentation: complete critical shield, two slabs, 3-4 chunks, falling fragments, final chips.
break_fx_x2: Five-frame energy-spine failure: full impact, corner cracks, four plate sections, outward fall, final chips.
